meta.name: description
meta.content: Founded in 1988 by Tony Wilson in Jamaica, The Company Dance Theatre gained national acclaim for its vibrant mix of modern, contemporary, and Jamaican-styled dance, performing locally and internationally. CDT Jamaica now continues his legacy focusing on modern dance training, inspiring performances, and community outreach in Jamaica and beyond.

CDT Jamaica now continues his legacy focusing on modern dance training, inspiring performances, and community outreach in Jamaica and beyond.

meta.content: CDT Jamaica, Jamaican dance, cultural dance theatre, Caribbean dance, dance performances, dance workshops, Tony Wilson, Jamaican culture, contemporary dance, folk dance
